translations.web: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.
translations.bsb: Every morning each one gathered as much as was needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.
translations.kjv: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
translations.asv: And they gathered it morning by morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
